saved_sources.bridge: original Native map and physical-survey bridge deck polygon; source hash required
saved_sources.trace: original per-frame Native body footprint and velocity at 20 Hz; source hash required

comparison: Compare candidate stationary intervals with full versus no bridge-deck overlap, holding the bridge map and stop purpose fixed. Preserve partial overlap as unresolved rather than assigning a statutory cutoff.
exception_sources_required: other traffic location, motion and conflict timing
purpose of halt and whether it was necessary to avoid conflict
applicable law and police or official traffic-control directions
limitations: The 0.1 m/s stationary candidate filter is an engineering screen, not a legal definition of stop, stand or park.
Bridge construction, physical support, original velocity and exception facts require independent Native and source review.
This CPU proof neither establishes legal compliance nor reuses accepted recordings.
